selection_order: smallest squared distance from initial cutoffs
calls: One assessment and one relevance request per case, assessment first; 16 model requests total if all succeed. No retries or prompt changes.
held_out_rule: Save chosen cutoffs and their development evidence before requesting held-out scores. Preserve held-out failures without retuning.
scope: Single run per fixed-order synthetic case; no execution, variance estimate or isolated readiness ablation.
